question: What result can arise from a single measure of nighttime recitation of dakṣiṇā?
premises: Even one measure of recitation is performed.
Dakṣiṇā becomes a giver of success.
inference: By even one measure of nighttime recitation, dakṣiṇā may grant success.
uncertainties: The exact quantity meant by eka+mātra is not specified.
plain_english: At night, by even a single measure of recitation, dakṣiṇā may become the giver of success.
